description:
• Work with Business Solutions analysts and business personnel to understand procurement to pay business processes and provide the technology to support these processes 
 • Based on requirements submitted by the business, develop detailed functional and technical specifications for changes to the SAP systems 
 • Primary responsibility for incident management and resolution for area of responsibility 
 • Understand and follow all relevant standard LyondellBasell IT processes and procedures 
 • Perform configuration for the P2P and SRM modules including integrated components within MM, QM and Warehouse Management 
 • Consult with ABAP developers and provide technical specs to develop customized solutions 
 • Perform unit testing of changes (configuration, custom development, etc) in development and staging environments, including regression testing of functionality that may be impacted by change. 
 • Coordinate long chain testing where appropriate of changes (configuration, custom development, etc.) in development and staging environments 
 • Provide input and suggestions based on knowledge of area of responsibility 
 • Provide prototypes of new functionality based on client needs • Investigate and resolve incidents reported by users 
 • Provide support for other activities that impact the MM/SRM area, such as configuration changes to support changing business conditions, SAP ECC upgrades, application of hot packs, project work, etc. 

 KEY COMPENTENCIES: 
 • Demonstrated proficiency in SAP Supplier Relationship Management, Materials Management and Procurement 
 • 10+ years SAP experience required 
 • Experience with large SAP ERP global rollouts. 
 • Technical leadership experience in architecting and collaborating with business process architect groups to develop efficient technical solutions in the areas of procure to pay, supplier relationship management, and materials management. 
 • Leadership in development, implement and support of global initiatives at various time zones. 
 • Ability to relate technical ideas and functionality to non-technical user 
 • Strong organizational, oral/written communication, interpersonal and agency/client relationship skills. 
 • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
